services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: The Lewistown Art Center is available for rental! Host meetings, parties, performances, art classes and more. With three floors and over 8,000 square feet to play with, we can accommodate most groups and events. The Mezzanine overlooking the main gallery floor is an ideal space for small parties or meetings, comfortably accommodating up to 25 people. Available at no charge during business hours; we ask guests to make a donation in the amount of their choice to help support our operating costs. Usage fee for outside business hours is $25/hr. Tables and chairs provided. The beautiful Margie Wilkins Gallery is a perfect space for artist receptions, performances or larger events up to 100
